questions.title: Ad IDs from Meta come back slightly wrong after passing through a Go service
questions.title_zh: Meta 的广告 ID 经过一个 Go 服务之后，回来时变得“差了一点”
questions.question:
A Go service proxies ad-platform reports. To stay flexible it decodes each response with `json.Unmarshal` into `map[string]any`, adds a few fields, and re-encodes it for the frontend. Merchants report that clicking an ad opens the wrong ad, or a 404: the ID `120210000123456789` arrives as `120210000123456780`. Small IDs are fine.

Explain the cause and how to fix it on the Go side and in the API contract.
questions.question_zh:
一个 Go 服务代理广告平台的报表。为了保持灵活，它用 `json.Unmarshal` 把每个响应解码到 `map[string]any`，补几个字段，再重新编码发给前端。商家反馈点击某条广告时打开的是另一条广告，或者直接 404：ID `120210000123456789` 到达时变成了 `120210000123456780`。比较小的 ID 则没有问题。

解释原因，以及如何在 Go 侧和 API 契约层面修复。
questions.answer:
**Cause.** When `encoding/json` decodes a number into an `interface{}` (`any`), it uses `float64`. A float64 has a 53-bit mantissa, so integers above 2^53 (9,007,199,254,740,992) cannot all be represented; `120210000123456789` becomes the nearest float, `1.2021000012345678e+17`, which is `120210000123456784`. When the map is encoded again, Go prints the shortest decimal that round-trips to that float, `120210000123456780`. Small IDs fit exactly, which is why the bug only hits large IDs.

**Fixes on the Go side.**

- Decode into typed structs with `int64` (or `string`) fields wherever the shape is known; `int64` holds the value exactly.
- When you really need a generic map, use a `json.Decoder` with `UseNumber()`. Numbers then decode as `json.Number`, a string type that keeps the original digits and re-encodes them unchanged; call `.Int64()` when you need arithmetic.
- Better still, do not decode and re-encode payloads you only pass through: keep them as `json.RawMessage` and add your fields around them.

```go
dec := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body)
dec.UseNumber()
var m map[string]any
if err := dec.Decode(&m); err != nil {
	return err
}
// m["ad_id"] is json.Number("120210000123456789"), not float64
```

**Fix the API contract too.** Even if Go keeps the digits, a browser parsing the JSON with `JSON.parse` turns the number into a JavaScript double and loses the same precision (`Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` is 2^53 - 1). Send IDs as strings. In Go, the `,string` tag option does this for numeric fields: a field `ID int64` with the tag `json:"id,string"` encodes as `"120210000123456789"`. Note that it then also requires a quoted value when decoding; an unquoted number fails with an error, so apply it only to fields whose producers send strings.

**Trade-offs and prevention.** Treat external IDs as opaque strings end to end: you never do arithmetic on them, and strings survive every language and database. Add a test that round-trips a value above 2^53 through each layer, because ordinary fixtures with small IDs will never catch this.
questions.answer_zh:
**原因。** `encoding/json` 把数字解码到 `interface{}`（`any`）时使用的是 `float64`。float64 只有 53 位尾数，所以大于 2^53（9,007,199,254,740,992）的整数无法全部精确表示；`120210000123456789` 会变成最接近的浮点数 `1.2021000012345678e+17`，也就是 `120210000123456784`。再次编码这个 map 时，Go 输出能还原成该浮点数的最短十进制表示，即 `120210000123456780`。小的 ID 能精确表示，所以这个 bug 只影响大 ID。

**Go 侧的修复。**

- 只要结构是已知的，就解码到带 `int64`（或 `string`）字段的类型化结构体中；`int64` 能精确保存这个值。
- 确实需要通用 map 时，使用 `json.Decoder` 并调用 `UseNumber()`。这样数字会被解码为 `json.Number`，它是一个字符串类型，保留原始数字，重新编码时原样输出；需要计算时再调用 `.Int64()`。
- 更好的做法是：只做透传的内容不要解码再编码，把它们保留为 `json.RawMessage`，把你的字段加在外层。

```go
dec := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body)
dec.UseNumber()
var m map[string]any
if err := dec.Decode(&m); err != nil {
	return err
}
// m["ad_id"] is json.Number("120210000123456789"), not float64
```

**同时修复 API 契约。** 即使 Go 保留了原始数字，浏览器用 `JSON.parse` 解析时也会把数字转成 JavaScript 的 double，丢失同样的精度（`Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` 是 2^53 - 1）。ID 应该以字符串形式发送。在 Go 中，数值字段可以用 `,string` 标签选项实现：带有标签 `json:"id,string"` 的字段 `ID int64` 会被编码为 `"120210000123456789"`。注意，这样解码时也要求值带引号；未加引号的数字会报错，所以只在生产方发送字符串的字段上使用它。

**取舍与预防。** 从头到尾把外部 ID 当作不透明的字符串：你从不对它们做算术运算，而字符串在任何语言和数据库之间都不会出问题。加一个测试，让一个大于 2^53 的值在每一层往返一遍，因为普通的、ID 较小的测试数据永远发现不了这个问题。
followups: Why does re-encoding print ...780 rather than ...784?
What breaks if you add the `,string` tag to a field that a partner sends as a bare number?
Where else in a stack can a 64-bit ID silently lose precision?
followups_zh: 为什么重新编码时打印的是 ...780 而不是 ...784？
如果给一个合作方以裸数字发送的字段加上 `,string` 标签，会出什么问题？
在整个技术栈中，64 位 ID 还可能在哪些地方悄无声息地丢失精度？

vocab.zh: json.Number（保留原始数字的字符串类型）

questions.title: Feature flags and gradual rollouts for a multi-tenant SaaS
questions.title_zh: 多租户 SaaS 中的功能开关与灰度发布
questions.question:
Your team ships a new checkout flow and a new ad-sync engine. Product wants to turn features on for internal stores first, then 5% of merchants, then everyone, and to switch a feature off within a minute if it misbehaves, without a deploy. About 40 services in Go and Java need to read the flags.

Design the feature flag system.
questions.question_zh:
你的团队要上线新的结账流程和新的广告同步引擎。产品希望先对内部店铺打开功能，再扩大到 5% 的商家，最后全量；如果功能出问题，要能在一分钟内关掉，而且不需要发版。大约 40 个 Go 和 Java 服务需要读取这些开关。

设计这个功能开关系统。
questions.answer:
**Data model.** A flag has a key, a type (boolean or variant), a default, and an ordered list of rules: explicit allow or deny lists of tenants, attribute rules (plan, region, internal store), and a percentage rollout. Every change is versioned with who changed it and why, so you can audit and roll back.

**Stable percentage rollout.** Hash the tenant ID together with the flag key, for example `hash(flag_key + ":" + tenant_id) % 10000`, and enable the flag when the bucket is below the rollout threshold. Including the flag key means different flags pick different 5% groups, so the same merchants are not always the guinea pigs. Raising the threshold from 5% to 20% keeps the first 5% enabled, so nobody flips back and forth.

**Evaluation in the services.** Do not call a flag service on every request; that adds latency and makes the flag service a single point of failure. Each service runs an SDK that keeps the full rule set in memory, evaluates locally in microseconds, and receives updates by streaming (SSE or a watch on etcd or a similar store) with periodic polling as a fallback. That gives the one-minute kill switch.

- If the SDK cannot reach the flag service at startup, it uses a last-known snapshot from local disk or the code default, and the default should be the safe, old behaviour.
- Evaluate a flag once per request or job and pass the result along, so one checkout does not mix old and new code paths when a flag changes mid-request.
- Log flag evaluations (sampled) with the tenant and variant, so metrics and errors can be split by variant and a bad rollout is visible on dashboards.

**Trade-offs.** Flags are technical debt: every flag doubles a code path. Give each flag an owner and an expiry date, alert on flags fully on or off for weeks, and remove them. Keep long-lived configuration (plan limits) separate from release flags. Building this yourself is reasonable at this scale, but an off-the-shelf tool (LaunchDarkly, Unleash, OpenFeature-compatible SDKs) saves you the SDKs in two languages.
questions.answer_zh:
**数据模型。** 一个开关包含键、类型（布尔或多变体）、默认值，以及一组有序的规则：显式的租户允许或拒绝名单、属性规则（套餐、地区、是否内部店铺），以及按百分比灰度。每次修改都带版本号，记录修改人和原因，便于审计和回滚。

**稳定的百分比灰度。** 把租户 ID 和开关键一起做哈希，例如 `hash(flag_key + ":" + tenant_id) % 10000`，当桶号小于灰度阈值时打开开关。把开关键纳入哈希，意味着不同开关会选出不同的 5% 群体，不会总是同一批商家当小白鼠。把阈值从 5% 提高到 20% 时，原来那 5% 仍然保持打开，没有人会来回切换。

**在服务中求值。** 不要每个请求都去调用开关服务；那会增加延迟，并让开关服务成为单点故障。每个服务运行一个 SDK，把完整的规则集保存在内存中，在本地以微秒级完成求值，并通过流式推送（SSE，或对 etcd 等存储的 watch）接收更新，同时以定期轮询作为兜底。这样就能实现一分钟内的紧急关闭。

- 如果 SDK 启动时连不上开关服务，就使用本地磁盘上最后一次的快照或代码中的默认值，而默认值应该是安全的旧行为。
- 每个请求或任务只对开关求值一次并向下传递结果，这样在请求处理过程中开关发生变化时，同一次结账不会混用新旧代码路径。
- （抽样）记录开关求值结果，带上租户和变体，这样指标和错误可以按变体拆分，糟糕的灰度能在看板上直接看出来。

**取舍。** 开关是技术债：每个开关都会让代码路径翻倍。给每个开关指定负责人和过期日期，对连续数周全开或全关的开关发出告警，然后删除它们。把长期存在的配置（套餐额度）和发布开关分开。在这个规模下自建是合理的，但现成的工具（LaunchDarkly、Unleash、兼容 OpenFeature 的 SDK）能省去你在两种语言里各写一个 SDK 的工作。
followups: How would you run an A/B experiment on top of this, and what changes?
A flag change caused an incident. How do you find which change and who made it within minutes?
followups_zh: 你会如何在此基础上做 A/B 实验，需要改变什么？
一次开关变更引发了事故。你如何在几分钟内找出是哪次变更、由谁做的？

vocab.zh: 稳定分桶（同一租户始终落在同一桶）

questions.title: Two admins remove each other at the same time, and a store is left with no owner
questions.title_zh: 两个管理员同时把对方移除，结果店铺一个所有者都没有了
questions.question:
A store must always have at least one owner. The service removes an owner in a transaction: `SELECT count(*) FROM store_owner WHERE store_id = $1`; if the count is greater than 1, `DELETE` the row and commit. Two owners of the same store each removed themselves within the same second, both requests succeeded, and the store now has zero owners. The team had already switched the transaction to REPEATABLE READ.

Name the anomaly, explain why REPEATABLE READ does not prevent it in PostgreSQL, and give fixes.
questions.question_zh:
一个店铺必须至少有一个所有者。服务在一个事务中移除所有者：`SELECT count(*) FROM store_owner WHERE store_id = $1`；如果数量大于 1，就 `DELETE` 这一行并提交。同一店铺的两个所有者在同一秒内各自移除了自己，两个请求都成功了，店铺现在一个所有者都没有。团队之前已经把这个事务改成了 REPEATABLE READ。

说出这种异常的名字，解释为什么在 PostgreSQL 中 REPEATABLE READ 防止不了它，并给出修复方法。
questions.answer:
**The anomaly is write skew.** Both transactions read the same set (two owners), each decides based on that read, and each writes a different row. Neither write conflicts with the other at the row level, so nothing blocks, yet together they break an invariant that spans rows.

**Why REPEATABLE READ does not help.** In PostgreSQL, REPEATABLE READ is snapshot isolation. Each transaction sees a consistent snapshot, and it only fails if it tries to update or delete a row that another transaction changed after the snapshot. Here they delete different rows, so both commit. Tested on PostgreSQL 16, both READ COMMITTED and REPEATABLE READ leave zero owners.

**Fixes.**

- Lock a common parent row: `SELECT 1 FROM store WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE` at the start. All changes to one store's owners then run one after another, and the second transaction counts again after the first commits. This is simple and the usual choice.
- Use SERIALIZABLE. PostgreSQL's serializable snapshot isolation tracks read/write dependencies and aborts one transaction with SQLSTATE `40001` ("could not serialize access due to read/write dependencies among transactions"). In the same test exactly one owner remained. The application must retry on 40001, and you pay some overhead and more aborts under contention.
- Make the check and the write one statement, for example a `DELETE ... WHERE ... AND (SELECT count(*) ...) > 1`. On its own this is still racy under READ COMMITTED, because the subquery does not lock the other rows; combine it with the parent-row lock or SERIALIZABLE.
- Store the invariant where a constraint can enforce it, such as an `owner_count` column on `store` with `CHECK (owner_count >= 1)`, updated in the same transaction. The row update then serializes concurrent removals.

**Trade-offs.** `FOR UPDATE` on the parent is explicit and cheap but every code path that changes owners must remember to take it. SERIALIZABLE protects paths you forgot, at the cost of retries everywhere; if you adopt it, all transactions that touch the data must run at SERIALIZABLE for the guarantee to hold. Whatever you choose, write a concurrency test that runs two removals in parallel, because single-threaded tests pass every time.
questions.answer_zh:
**这种异常叫写偏斜（write skew）。** 两个事务读取的是同一个集合（两个所有者），各自根据读到的结果做决定，然后各自写入不同的行。两次写入在行级别上互不冲突，所以没有任何阻塞，但合在一起却破坏了一个跨多行的不变式。

**为什么 REPEATABLE READ 没用。** 在 PostgreSQL 中，REPEATABLE READ 就是快照隔离。每个事务看到一个一致的快照，只有当它试图更新或删除一行、而这一行在快照之后被别的事务修改过时，才会失败。这里两个事务删除的是不同的行，所以都能提交。在 PostgreSQL 16 上测试，READ COMMITTED 和 REPEATABLE READ 都会留下零个所有者。

**修复方法。**

- 锁住共同的父行：在开始时执行 `SELECT 1 FROM store WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE`。这样对同一店铺所有者的修改会依次执行，第二个事务会在第一个提交之后重新计数。这种方法简单，也是最常用的选择。
- 使用 SERIALIZABLE。PostgreSQL 的可串行化快照隔离会跟踪读写依赖，并以 SQLSTATE `40001`（“could not serialize access due to read/write dependencies among transactions”）中止其中一个事务。在同样的测试中，最终恰好剩下一个所有者。应用必须在遇到 40001 时重试，而且你要付出一些开销，在争用时中止也会更多。
- 把检查和写入合成一条语句，例如 `DELETE ... WHERE ... AND (SELECT count(*) ...) > 1`。单独这样做在 READ COMMITTED 下仍然有竞态，因为子查询不会锁住其他行；需要配合父行锁或 SERIALIZABLE 使用。
- 把不变式放到约束能保证的地方，例如在 `store` 上加一个 `owner_count` 列并设置 `CHECK (owner_count >= 1)`，在同一事务中更新它。这样对这一行的更新会让并发的移除操作串行化。

**取舍。** 对父行使用 `FOR UPDATE` 明确且开销小，但每条修改所有者的代码路径都必须记得加锁。SERIALIZABLE 能保护你遗漏的路径，代价是到处都要重试；如果采用它，所有涉及这些数据的事务都必须以 SERIALIZABLE 运行，保证才能成立。无论选哪种，都要写一个并发测试，让两次移除并行执行，因为单线程测试每次都会通过。
followups: Why is a unique constraint not enough to enforce "at least one owner"?
How would you build a safe retry wrapper for 40001 errors?
Does MySQL InnoDB at REPEATABLE READ behave the same way here?
followups_zh: 为什么唯一约束不足以保证“至少一个所有者”？
你会如何为 40001 错误实现一个安全的重试封装？
MySQL InnoDB 在 REPEATABLE READ 下这里的行为一样吗？

questions.title: A Redis rate limiter blocks some merchants forever
questions.title_zh: 一个 Redis 限流器把部分商家永久挡在了门外
questions.question:
An API gateway limits each merchant to 100 requests per minute. For every request it runs `INCR rl:{merchant}:{minute}`, then `EXPIRE` on the key, and rejects the request if the counter is above 100. After a Redis failover, a few merchants are rejected every minute, and Redis memory keeps growing. `TTL` on some of those keys returns `-1`.

Explain what went wrong and design a correct limiter.
questions.question_zh:
一个 API 网关把每个商家限制为每分钟 100 次请求。每个请求执行 `INCR rl:{merchant}:{minute}`，然后对该键执行 `EXPIRE`，如果计数超过 100 就拒绝请求。一次 Redis 故障切换之后，少数商家每分钟都被拒绝，Redis 内存也在持续增长。对其中一些键执行 `TTL` 返回 `-1`。

解释出了什么问题，并设计一个正确的限流器。
questions.answer:
**What went wrong.** `INCR` creates a key without a TTL; `TTL` returns `-1` for such a key. The code sends `EXPIRE` as a separate command, so if the gateway crashes, times out, or Redis fails over between the two commands, the key lives forever. For per-minute keys that leaks memory. If the gateway uses a fixed key per merchant and resets it by expiry (a common variant), the counter never resets and the merchant stays blocked. Calling `EXPIRE` on every request also has a subtle bug: it keeps pushing the expiry forward, so a busy merchant's window never ends.

**Make it atomic.** Run the increment and the expiry in one Lua script, and set the TTL only when the key is new:

```lua
local n = redis.call('INCR', KEYS[1])
if n == 1 then
  redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[1])
end
return n
```

A script runs atomically on the Redis server, so no client failure can separate the two steps. A local test shows `TTL` of `-1` after a bare `INCR` and `60` after the script. Alternatives are `SET key 0 EX 60 NX` followed by `INCR` in a `MULTI` block, or Redis 7's `EXPIRE key 60 NX`, which only sets an expiry when none exists. As a safety net, add a periodic scan that fixes keys under the `rl:` prefix with no TTL.

- Fixed windows allow bursts at the boundary: 100 requests at 12:00:59 and 100 more at 12:01:00. A sliding window (two counters weighted by time, or a sorted set of timestamps) or a token bucket smooths this.
- Decide what happens when Redis is down: failing open keeps the API up but unprotected; failing closed protects downstream systems but rejects everyone. Most public APIs fail open with a local in-memory limit as a fallback.
- Return `429` with a `Retry-After` header, so well-behaved clients back off instead of retrying immediately.

**Trade-offs.** One Redis round trip per request is usually fine; at very high volume, keep a small local budget per gateway instance and sync with Redis in batches, accepting slightly inaccurate limits. In Redis Cluster, a per-merchant key spreads load across slots naturally.
questions.answer_zh:
**出了什么问题。** `INCR` 创建的键没有 TTL；对这样的键执行 `TTL` 会返回 `-1`。代码把 `EXPIRE` 作为单独的命令发送，所以如果网关在两条命令之间崩溃、超时，或者 Redis 发生故障切换，这个键就会永久存在。对按分钟生成的键来说，这会泄漏内存。如果网关对每个商家使用固定的键，靠过期来重置（一种常见的变体），计数器就永远不会重置，商家会一直被拒绝。每个请求都调用 `EXPIRE` 还有一个隐蔽的 bug：它会不断把过期时间往后推，导致繁忙商家的窗口永远不结束。

**让它原子化。** 用一个 Lua 脚本完成自增和设置过期，并且只在键是新建时设置 TTL：

```lua
local n = redis.call('INCR', KEYS[1])
if n == 1 then
  redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[1])
end
return n
```

脚本在 Redis 服务端原子执行，所以任何客户端故障都无法把这两步拆开。本地测试显示，单独执行 `INCR` 后 `TTL` 为 `-1`，执行脚本后为 `60`。替代方案是在 `MULTI` 块中先执行 `SET key 0 EX 60 NX` 再执行 `INCR`，或者使用 Redis 7 的 `EXPIRE key 60 NX`，它只在键没有过期时间时才设置。作为兜底，可以加一个定期扫描，修复 `rl:` 前缀下没有 TTL 的键。

- 固定窗口在边界处允许突发：12:00:59 来 100 次，12:01:00 再来 100 次。滑动窗口（按时间加权的两个计数器，或者存放时间戳的有序集合）或令牌桶可以把它平滑掉。
- 决定 Redis 不可用时怎么办：放行（fail open）能让 API 继续可用，但失去保护；拒绝（fail closed）能保护下游系统，但会拒绝所有人。大多数公共 API 选择放行，并以本地内存限流作为兜底。
- 返回 `429` 并附带 `Retry-After` 头，让行为良好的客户端退避，而不是立即重试。

**取舍。** 每个请求一次 Redis 往返通常没问题；在流量非常大时，可以在每个网关实例上保留一小块本地配额，再批量与 Redis 同步，接受限流略有误差。在 Redis Cluster 中，按商家划分的键会自然地把负载分散到各个槽上。
followups: How does a token bucket differ from a sliding window for bursty clients?
Why is a Lua script safer than MULTI/EXEC with a GET check in the middle?
followups_zh: 对于有突发流量的客户端，令牌桶和滑动窗口有什么不同？
为什么 Lua 脚本比中间夹着 GET 检查的 MULTI/EXEC 更安全？

questions.title: Parallel calls with CompletableFuture make the whole service slow, and errors arrive wrapped twice
questions.title_zh: 用 CompletableFuture 并行调用后整个服务都变慢了，异常还被包了两层
questions.question:
A Java service builds a merchant dashboard by calling four ad platforms in parallel with `CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> client.fetch(...))` and then `join()`. Under load, unrelated parts of the service that use parallel streams also become slow, some dashboard requests hang for minutes, and the error handler that catches `MetaApiException` never fires.

Explain the three problems and how to fix them.
questions.question_zh:
一个 Java 服务在构建商家看板时，用 `CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> client.fetch(...))` 并行调用四个广告平台，然后调用 `join()`。在高负载下，服务中使用并行流的其他不相关部分也变慢了，部分看板请求会挂起好几分钟，而捕获 `MetaApiException` 的错误处理代码从来没有被触发。

解释这三个问题以及如何修复。
questions.answer:
**Problem one: the common pool.** `supplyAsync` without an executor runs on `ForkJoinPool.commonPool()`, which has about one thread per CPU minus one (on a 4-CPU machine it reported a parallelism of 3). It is designed for short CPU-bound tasks. Blocking HTTP calls occupy those few threads, so other dashboard requests queue, and every parallel stream in the JVM, which shares the same pool, slows down too.

**Fix:** pass a dedicated, bounded executor for blocking I/O, sized for the downstream calls, with a bounded queue and a rejection policy. On Java 21, `Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()` is a good fit for blocking calls, combined with a semaphore if each platform has a concurrency limit.

**Problem two: no timeouts.** `join()` waits forever if one platform never answers. Set connect and read timeouts on the HTTP client, and bound each future with `orTimeout` (fails with `TimeoutException`) or `completeOnTimeout` (substitutes a fallback value). Note that neither cancels the underlying HTTP call; only the client timeout frees the thread.

**Problem three: wrapped exceptions.** An exception thrown inside the task completes the future exceptionally. `join()` rethrows it wrapped in `CompletionException`, and `get()` wraps it in `ExecutionException`, so `catch (MetaApiException e)` never matches. Unwrap with `getCause()`, or handle errors inside the chain with `exceptionally` or `handle`, so one failing platform yields a partial dashboard instead of failing everything:

```java
ExecutorService io = Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor();

CompletableFuture<Report> meta = CompletableFuture
    .supplyAsync(() -> metaClient.fetch(merchant), io)
    .orTimeout(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
    .exceptionally(t -> Report.unavailable("meta", t));

// same for the other platforms, then:
CompletableFuture.allOf(meta, google, tiktok, pinterest).join();
```

**Trade-offs.** Partial results need a clear signal in the UI and in metrics, otherwise failures go unnoticed. Executors must be shut down on application stop. Also watch context propagation: MDC, tracing and tenant ThreadLocals do not follow tasks to another thread unless you wrap the executor.
questions.answer_zh:
**问题一：公共线程池。** 不指定执行器的 `supplyAsync` 运行在 `ForkJoinPool.commonPool()` 上，它的线程数大约是 CPU 数减一（在 4 核机器上显示并行度为 3）。它是为短小的 CPU 密集型任务设计的。阻塞的 HTTP 调用占住了这几个线程，于是其他看板请求只能排队，而 JVM 中所有共用这个池的并行流也都跟着变慢。

**修复：** 为阻塞 I/O 传入一个专用的、有界的执行器，按下游调用来设定大小，并配上有界队列和拒绝策略。在 Java 21 上，`Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()` 很适合阻塞调用；如果每个平台有并发上限，再配合一个信号量。

**问题二：没有超时。** 如果某个平台一直不响应，`join()` 会永远等待。给 HTTP 客户端设置连接和读取超时，并用 `orTimeout`（以 `TimeoutException` 失败）或 `completeOnTimeout`（用兜底值代替）来约束每个 future。注意，这两者都不会取消底层的 HTTP 调用；只有客户端超时才能释放线程。

**问题三：被包装的异常。** 任务中抛出的异常会让 future 以异常方式完成。`join()` 会把它包装在 `CompletionException` 中重新抛出，`get()` 则包装在 `ExecutionException` 中，所以 `catch (MetaApiException e)` 永远匹配不上。用 `getCause()` 解包，或者在链中用 `exceptionally` 或 `handle` 处理错误，这样一个平台失败只会得到部分看板，而不是全部失败：

```java
ExecutorService io = Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor();

CompletableFuture<Report> meta = CompletableFuture
    .supplyAsync(() -> metaClient.fetch(merchant), io)
    .orTimeout(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
    .exceptionally(t -> Report.unavailable("meta", t));

// same for the other platforms, then:
CompletableFuture.allOf(meta, google, tiktok, pinterest).join();
```

**取舍。** 部分结果需要在界面和指标上有明确的标识，否则失败会被忽视。应用停止时要关闭执行器。还要注意上下文传递：MDC、链路追踪和租户 ThreadLocal 不会自动跟随任务到另一个线程，除非你对执行器做了包装。
